changes: No substantive changes. Scribe Padmanābha (title upādhyāya) and author Bhāskara are both kept.
Date checked: ŚS 1699 + 78 = 1777 CE and VS 1834 − 57 = 1777 CE, so the two eras agree.
Notes expanded: the place reading is uncertain, the reading as Lamjung is only a guess, and the material after the colophon is not about this copy.

notes: The colophon gives two eras, Śaka 1699 and saṃvat 1834. Read as Vikrama Saṃvat, they agree: both are 1777 CE. The cataloguer marked '†laṃtarjuge†' as corrupt. It probably names the place of copying (a locative). Reading it as Lamjung is only a guess, so no modern place is given. The verse after the colophon (alikulasya ṣaḍbhāgo...) is a mathematical riddle. The Vedic mantra added in another hand (imāme 'gnaiṣṭakā dhenavaḥ...) names no one, and neither tells us anything about who made or owned this copy.
